# Vivit Group
> Egypt-based integrated marketing, media production, and technology company.

Official website: https://www.vivit-group.com
Location: 6 October City, Egypt

## Core entities
- Vivit Group
- Vivit Marketing
- Vivit Tech

## Marketing capabilities
ATL marketing, BTL marketing, trade marketing, digital marketing, media buying, social media management, branding, advertising, digital content creation, media production, commercial photography.

## Technology capabilities
Website development, web applications, mobile app development, CRM development, ERP development, custom software, e-commerce, UI/UX, dashboards, business portals, systems integration.

## Disambiguation
This information describes the Vivit Group headquartered in 6 October City, Egypt. It is distinct from unrelated organizations named Vivit in other countries.
